clusters.text: California authorities have declared self-driving cars an ‘imminent hazard to public safety’ after traffic incidents. Waymo has paused its driverless taxi services on freeways across the United States after California temporarily banned the ride-hailing platform on the state’s highways over safety concerns. A spokesperson for the California-based company – a subsidiary of Alphabet, Google’s parent company – said it has “temporarily restricted commercial freeway rides in all markets where we operate that service”, but it is “continuing freeway testing with trained autonomous specialists behind the wheel”. Waymo implemented the suspension last Wednesday, according to the spokesperson, but they did not say how long it would last. Along with California, the driverless vehicles will pause highway services in Phoenix, Austin and Miami. Waymo offers rides on city streets in areas including Las Vegas, Dallas and Denver. The spokesperson said the suspension would allow the company to “evaluate our performance” following incidents in California and that it prioritises safety. One incident on November 6 went viral after video captured on a San Francisco highway showed a Waymo vehicle speeding towards and attempting to pass two police cars, even as their lights were flashing in an intentional bid to slow traffic. The officers were driving behind a slow-moving construction truck. The episode led the California Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) to temporarily ban Waymo vehicles from its highways, effective from November 11. The DMV, which is responsible for road safety, said its decision was also prompted by a November 5 incident, when three Waymo autonomous vehicles drove into a construction zone in the San Francisco Bay Area. Waymo said the construction zone incident did not result in injuries or collisions. DMV spokesman Jonathan Groveman said in a statement that “similar incidents” occurred on May 18. “The Department determined that Waymo’s driverless freeway operations pose an imminent hazard to public safety due to recurring incursions by its vehicles into active construction zones where construction workers, vehicles and equipment are present,” he said. The restrictions “will remain in place until Waymo demonstrates … it has taken effective corrective actions”, the statement read. clusters.text: As US President Donald Trump heads to China, his administration has renewed efforts to curb Beijing's access to advanced semiconductors. On Monday, Washington announced new interim rules that will increase scrutiny of data centre operators in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia and Brazil. The move not only restricts the export of advanced chips, but also access to their computing power, which Chinese firms currently rent abroad to train artificial intelligence (AI) models. South East Asian countries in particular have invested heavily in data centres to power their AI ambitions - and Chinese firms seeking computing power overseas have been a key market. But now these firms will need a US government licence to buy advanced chips from Nvidia or other American chipmakers. This allows Washington to monitor if those chips are being used to serve Chinese companies, or being smuggled to China. This poses a fresh challenge for Beijing, which has become deeply dependent on compute from abroad in the wake of US export restrictions. At least 30% of China's advanced AI computing power is projected to come from renting overseas or smuggling in 2027, according to research by the Institute for Progress , external , a US-based think-tank. China's foreign ministry called the new rules "economic coercion" and said Beijing "will take necessary measures to firmly safeguard its own legitimate rights and interests". This is also a problem for South East Asian economies where large numbers of data centres have sprung up recently. Some of the firms behind them are accused of helping China evade US export controls on advanced chips. One of those is Singaporean data centre firm Megaspeed, whose former director Alice Huang is suspected of being a Chinese spy. Calls for tighter export controls have grown after Nvidia's Jensen Huang admited to an affair with her and resigned as CEO . Megaspeed, the biggest buyer of Nvidia's chips in South East Asia, is accused of illegally smuggling chips to Chinese companies after purchasing them for use in data centres in Malaysia, Indonesia and Thailand. clusters.text: Google today said it is bringing Google Wallet to iOS in the United States, giving users a way to make payments and manage purchases across Google services. Google Wallet cannot be used for tap-to-pay purchases in retail locations, but it otherwise serves as an alternative to Apple Wallet. It can store payment cards for online checkout with Google Pay, and it syncs with Gmail and other Google apps for features like package tracking and storing tickets and boarding passes. As with Apple Wallet, Google Wallet lets users add loyalty and gym membership cards, so there's no need to use a physical card. Google says users can manage "agentic purchases made across Google," with easy access to order confirmations, receipts, and delivery updates. Apple began allowing NFC contactless payments in third-party apps with iOS 18.1, but it requires a commercial agreement with Apple, so that may be why Google hasn't implemented support. clusters.text: New Delhi [India], November 17 (ANI): Iconic landmarks in the national capital, including Parliament House, Rashtrapati Bhavan, North Block, South Block and India Gate, were illuminated in teal blue on Tuesday evening to mark Cervical Cancer Elimination Day of Action. Visuals from central Delhi showed prominent government buildings and monuments illuminated in teal, the global awareness colour for cervical cancer, as part of efforts to raise awareness about prevention, early screening and timely treatment of the disease. Observed annually on November 17, the day commemorates the launch of the World Health Organization's (WHO) Global Strategy to Accelerate the Elimination of Cervical Cancer in 2020. The day is also recognised as World Cervical Cancer Elimination Day, with landmarks across the world illuminated in teal to highlight the global campaign against the disease. This year's campaign carries the theme "Together We Can Eliminate Cervical Cancer", emphasising the need to achieve the WHO's 90-70-90 targets by 2030. Under the targets, 90 per cent of girls are to be fully vaccinated against the Human Papillomavirus (HPV) by the age of 15, 70 per cent of women are to be screened using a high-performance test by the ages of 35 and 45, and 90 per cent of women diagnosed with cervical disease are to receive appropriate treatment. India has also stepped up its preventive healthcare efforts against cervical cancer. In February 2026, Prime Minister Narendra Modi launched a nationwide HPV vaccination drive to provide free vaccination to 14-year-old girls at government health facilities. The campaign aims to strengthen awareness about vaccination, screening and timely treatment to accelerate efforts towards eliminating cervical cancer as a public health problem. (ANI)

BJP protests in Ranchi, demands arrest of Cong MLA Bhushan Bara
clusters.text:
Ranchi, Nov 17 (PTI) BJP workers on Tuesday staged a demonstration outside the Lok Bhavan in Ranchi, demanding the immediate arrest of Congress MLA Bhushan Bara, who is accused of raping his minor domestic help.

Hundreds of party workers joined the demonstration, organised by the BJP's Scheduled Tribe (ST) Morcha.

"We are protesting against the sexual exploitation of a 14-year-old tribal girl. The victim has shown great courage by lodging an FIR against the MLA. Instead of properly investigating the matter, action is being taken against a journalist who exposed it," former MP Geeta Koda alleged.

"Hemant Soren is not going to take action against anyone. He came to power in the name of tribals, but tribals are being exploited," she alleged, warning of a bigger agitation if the government failed to act.

BJP ST Morcha's state president Sunny Toppo alleged that the JMM-led government was trying to cover up the case.

BJP leaders later submitted a memorandum to Governor Santosh Kumar Gangwar on their demands.

Toppo said the governor had taken cognisance of the memorandum and forwarded it for further action.

Referring to the alleged murder of a government employee by land mafias and the alleged rape of a tribal woman in Gamharia, Toppo said such incidents had left the tribal community of the state feeling "exploited and cheated".

The minor, a resident of Simdega district, alleged that Bara raped her at his residence on August 5, following which she became pregnant. She also claimed that a subsequent medical examination revealed that she had suffered a miscarriage.

Police registered an FIR against Bara under the POCSO Act and the Juvenile Justice Act at Dhurwa police station in Ranchi on November 13.

Hours later, two persons, including a digital content creator, were also booked on a complaint by the girl's grandfather for allegedly abducting her and coercing her into making a "false" statement against the two-time Congress legislator.

Bara's party, the Congress, is a constituent of the ruling JMM-led coalition.

The National Commission for Women (NCW) and the National Commission for Scheduled Tribes (NCST) have sought reports from the Jharkhand government over the allegations against the MLA, who has denied the charges. PTI RPS RPS SOM

clusters.text: HDFC Bank has notified customers of changes to the BizBlack Metal Credit Card, with the revised reward structure coming into effect from December 21, 2026. The changes cover three important aspects of the card: accelerated reward points on business expenses, quarterly milestone benefits and reward points on Income Tax and GST payments. BizBlack Metal is HDFC Bank’s premium business credit card, designed for self-employed individuals and business owners who have substantial business expenses. The card has traditionally been an interesting proposition for those who use it for tax payments, business travel, software subscriptions and other business-related expenses. The latest changes are mixed. While HDFC Bank is making the milestone benefit easier to achieve, it is also introducing a qualification requirement for accelerated reward points. This means customers who primarily use the card for tax payments will need to pay closer attention to their overall spending. The key change is the introduction of an INR 50,000 qualifying retail-spend requirement per statement cycle to unlock 5X accelerated reward points on tax payments. Watch | Prayagraj SIR Ground Report: Missing Muslim Voters Names and Thousands of Duplicate Entries
clusters.text: While Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Adityanath claims that names of over one crore Hindu voters have been removed from the electoral rolls, an on-the-ground investigation by The Wire in Prayagraj district reveals a different reality. In Muslim-majority areas, thousands of voters’ names have either been removed from the revised voter rolls or, due to various other errors, local residents are being forced to repeatedly fill out Forms 6 and 8.In this video report, we examine four assembly constituencies in Prayagraj – Allahabad South, Allahabad West, Phulpur and Soraon. Local residents as well as booth-level workers from the Samajwadi Party state that they have repeatedly alerted the Election Commission and the local administration of these irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) process.In the Atala neighbourhood, part of Allahabad South, Muslim voters share how elderly individuals were marked as 'deceased' in the electoral rolls without any prior survey, or simply had their names removed. A large number of those affected are Muslim women. Meanwhile, in Maudopur village (within the Soraon tehsil), also a Muslim-majority area, booth-level officers (BLOs) failed to conduct door-to-door visits to assist residents in filling out the necessary forms. In Phulpur, a constituency once represented by India’s first Prime Minister, Jawaharlal Nehru, Hindu voters are facing similar challenges. Jai Singh, for instance, told The Wire that the names of four members of his family are yet to be included in the rolls.Amidst all this, another alarming issue has emerged: the presence of 'duplicate voters' – instances involving identical names, distinct EPIC (Electoral Photo Identity Card) numbers and highly suspicious, often identical, addresses. To understand this complex issue of duplicate entries in the UP electoral rolls in depth, watch this ground report by Akanksha Kumar.
